mapper.sql: contract_id, previous_contract_id, creditor_id, debtor_id, principal_amount, interest_rate, repayment_type, start_date, maturity_date, repayment_day, status, address, contract_alias, terms, creditor_signature, debtor_signature, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT name AS creditor_name, birth_date AS creditor_birth_date FROM `user` WHERE user_id = #{creditorId}
SELECT name AS debtor_name, birth_date AS debtor_birth_date FROM `user` WHERE user_id = #{debtorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_contract ( previous_contract_id, creditor_id, debtor_id, principal_amount, interest_rate, repayment_type, start_date, maturity_date, repayment_day, status, address, contract_alias, terms, creditor_signature, debtor_signature, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT prev.contract_id, COALESCE(prev.creditor_id, #{creditorId}), COALESCE(prev.debtor_id, #{debtorId}), COALESCE(prev.principal_amount, #{principalAmount}), COALESCE(prev.interest_rate, #{interestRate}), COALESCE(prev.repayment_type, #{repaymentType}), COALESCE(prev.start_date, #{startDate}), COALESCE(prev.maturity_date, #{maturityDate}), COALESCE(prev.repayment_day, #{repaymentDay}), COALESCE(prev.status, #{status}), COALESCE(prev.address, #{address}), COALESCE(prev.contract_alias, #{contractAlias}), COALESCE(prev.terms, #{terms}), COALESCE(prev.creditor_signature, #{creditorSignature}), COALESCE(prev.debtor_signature, #{debtorSignature}), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} FROM DUAL LEFT JOIN loan_contract prev ON prev.contract_id = #{previousContractId}
